category: Man-made objects whose primary function or characteristic involves rotation
explanation: All tokens except 'Planet' are man-made objects designed for or characterized by their rotational movement as a primary function. 'Planet' is a natural celestial body.

Christopher Columbus, Ferdinand Magellan, Vasco da Gama, and James Cook are all famous for their extensive sea voyages that opened new maritime routes across oceans. Marco Polo is primarily known for his groundbreaking land-based expeditions along the Silk Road.
SUN (one), TOO (two), FOR (four), and EIGHT (eight) are all homophones of English numbers. BEE is a homophone of the letter 'B', not a number.
